Data.purpose: Point d'entrée serveur réutilisable qui applique identité, session, limitation de débit et permission avant tout handler métier.
rules: No business handler runs before session and permission checks complete.
The route table is server-side and never trusted from the browser.
Authentication, authorization and rate-limit failures are audited without logging secrets.
Project handlers remain separate from framework security mechanics.
For Apps Script-hosted UIs, google.script.run is the preferred transport to avoid cross-origin API coupling.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Gateway générique destiné aux applications statiques ou hybrides qui utilisent Apps Script comme backend privé.
